description: This file contains a series of tests for the 'git for-each-ref' command, including parsing and formatting of references, signatures, trailers, sorting, and various formatting options. It appears to be a test script for verifying the behavior of 'git for-each-ref' in different scenarios.

methods.name: setdate_and_increment
methods.description: Sets the GIT_COMMITTER_DATE and GIT_AUTHOR_DATE environment variables to the current datestamp and then increments the datestamp.

methods.name: test_object_file_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a Git object file corresponding to the provided ref.

methods.name: test_atom
methods.description: Performs a test on a git for-each-ref atom with specific parameters and verifies the output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expecting success with specified commands and checks.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.
